verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an API-first payments platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI 3.1.0 mention refers to the specification format, not to versioning of the Rainforest API itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
